summary: WebRender's GPU rendering pipeline received significant performance and feature improvements, including more efficient graphics memory management through buffer sharing and instance reuse. Support was added for advanced CSS features like rounded corners with custom shapes (superellipse), and the rendering system was cleaned up by removing legacy code paths that were no longer needed. Various visual bugs were fixed—such as incorrect color blending, gradient artifacts, and text scaling issues—and the internals were refactored to be more maintainable, with several existing rendering algorithms replaced with more modern approaches.
